question: In an election between two candidates, 85% of the registered voters cast their vote and 4% of the votes polled were found invalid. The winning candidate got 65% of the valid votes and won the election by a margin of 2142 votes. How many voters were registered?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let total registered voters be N.

Valid votes = N × (85/100) × (96/100) = N × (17/20) × (24/25)

Winning margin = (65% − 35%) of valid votes = 30% = 3/10 of valid votes.

Equation: N × (17/20) × (24/25) × (3/10) = 2142

⇒ N × 1224 ÷ 5000 = 2142 ⇒ N = (2142 × 5000) ÷ 1224 = 8750

**∴ The correct answer is 8750 voters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Registered voters who cast their vote = 85%

Invalid votes = 4% of polled votes

Winner gets 65% of valid votes

Winning margin = 2142 votes

**Formula Used:**

Margin = Winner's Votes − Loser's Votes

Valid Votes = Polled Votes − Invalid Votes
